audit: Read-only mechanical candidate r33 package audit
method: Read the two specified evidence inventories and only the 36 explicit paths in each package.
Compare exact raw bytes without newline normalization; compute byte counts, SHA-256, and Git blob SHA-1 using SHA1("blob " + ASCII byte count + NUL + bytes).
Constrain the root SKILL.md version replacement to YAML frontmatter metadata.version and the profile-manifest replacement to the top-level protocol_revision JSON field.
Verify one forward r32-to-r33 and one inverse r33-to-r32 replacement per changed file reproduce the complete counterpart bytes.
Resolve every inventoried bundled hash declaration at its JSON pointer in the current and candidate declaration source and compare it with freshly calculated raw target bytes.

limits: This is a local mechanical byte-integrity audit only; no teaching, scientific-content, learner, or behavioral evaluation was performed.

Only the two named evidence files and the 36 explicit package paths under each named package root were read. No teaching/source/reports/history directories outside those explicit package paths were read.
No package directory enumeration was performed, so absence of additional unlisted files was not independently asserted.
The internal-hashes.json inventory defines the 34 bundled declarations and their target resolution; no independent census or reinterpretation of all possible declarations was performed.
The 31 excluded external or historical nonbundled declarations reported by the supplied inventory were not fetched, hashed, or revalidated.
Current package identities were compared with the expected identities carried by internal-hashes.json; the original inputs manifest was not opened.
No GitHub, browser, repository history, publication state, remote commit identity, external source, or access control was checked.
No package file or publication was mutated; only evidence/candidate-package-check.json was written.
